annotations.title: Eye
annotations.text: Lets us see. It focuses light onto the back of the eye, and the brain turns that into images.

annotations.title: Nose
annotations.text: Lets us smell and breathe. It also warms and cleans the air on its way to the lungs.

annotations.title: Mouth
annotations.text: Used to eat, speak and breathe. The tongue inside lets us taste.

annotations.title: Ear
annotations.text: Lets us hear. Deep inside, it also helps us keep our balance.

annotations.title: Neck
annotations.text: Holds up the head and lets it turn, nod and tilt.
